describe: The image shows a corroded metal wall, a rusty orange-brown plate covered in dark brown and black oxidation blotches and streaks. The upper part is deep rust red fading into orange-brown, while the lower band is weathered pale grey and off-white with flaking paint patches. Irregular stains, speckles and drips run vertically. Lighting is even with moderate contrast, and the surface is roughly flat with no tiling pattern.
